mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payments ( payment_id, order_id, method, amount, paid_at ) VALUES ( #{paymentId}, #{orderId}, #{method}, #{amount}, #{paidAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT p.payment_id, p.order_id, o.order_no, p.method, p.amount, p.paid_at FROM payments p JOIN orders o ON o.id = p.order_id WHERE p.payment_id = #{paymentId}
